description: The chart illustrates the accuracy of three models - Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni - when processing audio and noise inputs, comparing their performance to random choice. The horizontal axis lists the model names in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model is associated with two bars: a blue bar representing audio input accuracy and a purple bar for noise input accuracy. The blue bars have values of approximately 29%, 37%, and 57% for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the corresponding purple bars have values of around 22%, 29%, and 35%. A dashed gray line indicates the random choice accuracy at 30%. The bars are grouped by model, with no specific sorting order beyond the fixed model order on the horizontal axis, and no visual emphasis is applied to any of the bars.
